boundary_theorem.statement: Two X-boundaried CNFs are indistinguishable by all gluing contexts iff their existentially projected model relations on X are equal.
boundary_theorem.gluing_test: SAT(G AND H) iff R_G intersects R_H
boundary_theorem.firewall: class count as a function of t is not a SAT lower bound in original input length L

retired_framing.problem: all-context equivalence is just equality of projected Boolean functions and would hide semantic equivalence

minimal_unsafe_atom.name: NAE3
minimal_unsafe_atom.formula: (x OR y OR z) AND (not x OR not y OR not z)
minimal_unsafe_atom.role: minimal Horn x dual-Horn relation outside principal Schaefer tractable closures

stress_family.source: Darmann-Doecker-Dorn 2024, An even simpler hard variant of Not-All-Equal 3-SAT
stress_family.scope: monotone linear 3-uniform k-regular NAE with edges partitioned into k perfect matchings, NP-complete for fixed k>=4
stress_family.encoding: each NAE edge -> positive OR3 clause + negative OR3 clause

diagnostic_ceiling: finite heuristic census only; no asymptotic lower bound and no complexity conclusion
